qe: In April 1762 the Court of Directors in England ordered its Council in Calcutta not to commit any hostility against the Dutch, but to aid and defend them if which authority molested them?
qh: अप्रैल 1762 में इंग्लैंड में कोर्ट ऑफ डायरेक्टर्स ने कलकत्ता की अपनी काउंसिल को आदेश दिया कि डचों के विरुद्ध कोई शत्रुता न की जाए, बल्कि यदि कौन-सा शासक उन्हें परेशान करे तो उनकी सहायता तथा रक्षा की जाए?
e: Bedara (1759) ke baad Dutch ki sthiti kamzor ho gayi thi tatha Holland me Dutch East India Company ke directaron ne apni shikayatein rakhi thi, jiske kaaran Netherlands ke States General ne bharat ke liye sena bhejne ki taiyari shuru kar di thi. Isse bade takrao ka khatra dekh kar England ke Secretary of State Earl of Bute ne Company ke Directaron ko salah di ki woh dono deshon ke beech ke jhagde door karein. Isi salah ke aadhaar par April 1762 me Court of Directors ne Calcutta Council ko likha ki Dutch Company ke karmcharion ke viruddh koi shatruta ki karwai na ki jaye, balki unse madad-bhav rakha jaye; agar Nawab unjustly Dutch Company ko Bengal me pareshan kare ya unke vyapar tatha sampatti ko nuksan pahunchane ki koshish kare, to Company unki taraf se beech me pade tatha unhe nyay dilane me madad kare. Exam point: April 1762 me Court of Directors ne Calcutta Council ko aadesh diya ki Dutch ke viruddh koi shatruta na ho tatha agar Nawab unhe pareshan kare to unki sahayata tatha raksha ki jaye; yah nirdesh Earl of Bute ki salah par diya gaya tha.

qe: The English East India Company established a monopoly of the manufacture and trade of which article in Bihar in 1761?
qh: अंग्रेज ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी ने 1761 में बिहार में किस वस्तु के निर्माण तथा व्यापार पर एकाधिकार स्थापित कर लिया था?
e: 1761 me angrej East India Company ne Bihar me afim ke nirman tatha vyapar par ekadhikar yaani monopoly sthapna kar liya, jiske baad anya European companies ko is vastu ki sirf seemit matra hi kharidne ki anumati di gayi. Afim (opium) ek aisi fasal se banta hai jiski kheti Patna tatha Gaya kshetra me purani thi; isliye is vyapar par niyantran ka matlab tha ki munafe ka bada hissa angrejon ke haath me chala jaye. Dutch tatha French companies ne is ekadhikar ke viruddh Patna tatha Chinsura se kai memorial yaani likhit shikayatein bhejin, jiske baad Governor Verelst ne 12 March 1767 ko Muhammad Reza Khan ko aadesh diya ki is vyapar me unhe unka uchit hissa milne se roke jane wale avrodh hata diye jayein. Exam point: 1761 me English East India Company ne Bihar me afim (opium) ke nirman tatha vyapar par ekadhikar sthapna kiya; anya European companies ko sirf seemit matra milti thi; Dutch-French ne memorial bheje tatha 12 March 1767 ko Verelst ne Muhammad Reza Khan ko avrodh hatane ka aadesh diya.

qe: In 1763 the English Company's Resident at which place complained that the Dutch gomastas were obstructing English investments by clandestine purchases from the weavers?
qh: 1763 में किस स्थान पर अंग्रेज कंपनी के रेसिडेंट ने शिकायत की कि डच गुमाश्ते बुनकरों से चोरी-छिपे खरीद कर अंग्रेजों के निवेश को रोक रहे हैं?
e: Bedara (1759) ke baad angrejon tatha Dutch ke beech rishte theek nahi the, chahe dono ke beech khuli takkar nahi hui. 1763 me English Company ke Resident at Maldah ne Calcutta Council ko shikayat bheji ki Dutch ke gomastas yaani vyaparik aadmi bade paimana par angrejon dwara lagaye gaye bunakaron se chori-chhipe khareed kar angreji investment ko rok rahe hain. Investment ka arth us daur me woh mal tha jo Europe bhejne ke liye ekatra kiya jaata tha, aur bunakar dono companies ke liye kapda banate the. Aisi shikayatein dikhati hain ki 18vein sadi me European companies aapas me sasta mal jama karne ki kadi pratiyogita karti thi, chahe rajnitik roop se unke sambandh kaise bhi rahein. Exam point: 1763 me Maldah ke Resident ne shikayat ki, Dutch gomastas bunakaron se chori-chhipe khareed kar angreji investment rok rahe hain; us daur me investment = Europe bhejne ke liye ekatra kiya gaya mal; Dutch tatha angrejon me khuli takkar nahi hui thi.

qe: News of the Patna massacre of 1763 reached Calcutta through correspondence of the Dutch at Chinsura, who had learnt of it from a letter written by which chief of the Dutch factory at Patna?
qh: 1763 के पटना नरसंहार की खबर कलकत्ता उन डचों के पत्र-व्यवहार से पहुँची जो चिनसुरा में थे, और जिन्हें यह बात पटना की डच फैक्ट्री के किस प्रमुख के पत्र से मिली?
e: Patna me 1763 me angreji kaidiyon ka narsankhar hua tha tatha uski khabar sabse pehle kshetra ke vyapariyon tatha company karmcharion ke zariye phaili. Patna ki Dutch factory ke pramukh John Bacheracht tatha unke second adhikari Andries Schultz ne Chinsura ke Dutch Council ke logon ko, jinme Louis Taillefert bhi the, khat likh kar Patna kshetra ki halat batayi; usi patra-vyavahar se Chinsura ke Dutch logon ko ghatna ka pata chala tatha aage Calcutta me angreji Council ko yah khabar pahunchi. Bacheracht Patna ki Dutch factory ke chief the, isliye yah prashn unke naam par hai. De Wilde Cassimbazar ki factory se jude the tatha 1760 me Nawab ne unhe giraftar kiya tha. Exam point: Patna ki Dutch factory ke chief John Bacheracht tatha unke second Andries Schultz ne Chinsura ke Dutch Council ko khat likh kar 1763 ki ghatna batayi; usi patra-vyavahar se Calcutta ko khabar pahunchi; De Wilde Cassimbazar factory se jude the.

qe: In 1767 the Dutch complained to Governor Verelst that their boats were often detained at the customs-houses by which class of officials?
qh: 1767 में डचों ने गवर्नर वेरेल्स्ट से शिकायत की कि उनकी नावों को सीमा-शुल्क केंद्रों पर कौन-वर्ग के कर्मचारी बार-बार रोक लेते हैं?
e: 1767 me Dutch logon ne Calcutta ke Governor Verelst se shikayat ki, unki navon ko customs-houses yaani chaukiyon par chaukidar baar-baar rok lete hain tatha unse vah rakam vasool karne lagte hain jo unke hisaab se galat hai. Chaukidar logon ka dosh poora nahi tha, kyunki unhe European companies ki navon par jane wale maal ki jaanch karne tatha us par lag (duty) lene ka adhikar tha. Governor Verelst ne Muhammad Reza Khan, jo us samay Murshidabad ke naib nazim the, se kaha ki woh Dutch ki shikayaton ka hal karein, tatha yeh bhi sochna chahiye ki jaanch ke niyam dono taraf - angrej tatha anya European companies par - ek jaisa lage. Exam point: 1767 me Dutch ne Governor Verelst se shikayat ki, unki navon ko customs-houses par chaukidar rok lete hain; chaukidars ko jaanch tatha duty lene ka adhikar tha; Verelst ne naib nazim Muhammad Reza Khan ko shikayat door karne ka mandat diya.

qe: To redress the Dutch complaints about the detention of their boats in 1767, Governor Verelst asked which naib nazim at Murshidabad to take the necessary steps?
qh: 1767 में नावों को रोके जाने की डच शिकायतों को दूर करने के लिए गवर्नर वेरेल्स्ट ने मुर्शिदाबाद के किस नायब नाज़िम से जरूरी कदम उठाने को कहा?
e: 1767 me Dutch company ke logon ne Governor Verelst se shikayat ki, chaukidar unki navon ko customs par rok kar galat vasooliyaan karte hain. Governor Verelst ne is mudde par soch-vichar kar Muhammad Reza Khan se madad maangi; woh us samay Murshidabad ke naib nazim the, isliye customs tatha chaukiyon se juda prashasan unhi ke kshetra me aata tha. Unhe nirdesh diya gaya ki European companies ki navon ke saath bheje gaye dastak yaani parwana me sabhi jaankari likhi ho tatha recognised customs-stations par navon ki jaanch bhi ho, kyunki jaanch na hone par sarkar ka lag rah jaata hai tatha vyapari bina lag diye vyapar karte rahenge. Ant me Bhutmari ke chaukidar ko vah rakam lautane tatha naukri se hataye jaane ka aadesh diya gaya, jisne Dutch navon se zyada vasooli ki thi. Exam point: 1767 me Governor Verelst ne Murshidabad ke naib nazim Muhammad Reza Khan se Dutch shikayat door karne ko kaha; us daur me European companies ki navon ke saath dastak yaani parwana rahta tha; Bhutmari ke chaukidar ko vasool ki gayi rakam lautani padi.

qe: Early in 1767 the chaukidar of which place was dismissed and ordered to refund the money he had exacted from the Dutch boats?
qh: 1767 के आरंभ में किस स्थान के चौकीदार को बर्खास्त कर उससे डच नावों से वसूल की गई रकम लौटाने का आदेश दिया गया?
e: 1767 ke shuru me Dutch logon ne shikayat ki, Bhutmari ke chaukidar ne unki navon ko bewajah rok kar aam se zyada rakam vasool kar li. Chaukidar ko hataane se pehle Governor Verelst tatha naib nazim Muhammad Reza Khan ne yah dekha ki jaanch tatha duty lene ka adhikar to chauki wale karmcharion ko tha, lekin galat vasooli kisi haal me sahi nahi thi. Ant me us chaukidar ko vasool ki gayi rakam lautane tatha naukri se hatane ka aadesh diya gaya. Jahaz tatha nadiyaan us daur me Bihar tatha Bangal ke vyapar ki reedh ki haddi thi, isliye chaukiyon par navon ko roka jaana ek bada vyaparik mudda ban jaata tha. Exam point: Bhutmari ke chaukidar ne 1767 ke shuru me Dutch navon se aam se zyada rakam vasool ki thi, isliye usse rakam lautane tatha naukri se hataye jaane ka aadesh hua; chauki par jaanch tatha duty lene ka adhikar tha.

qe: In his instructions on the search of European boats, Governor Verelst named which three chowkies where search was necessary so that the sarkar's revenue was not defrauded?
qh: यूरोपीय नावों की तलाशी के निर्देश में गवर्नर वेरेल्स्ट ने किन तीन चौकियों का नाम लिया, जहाँ तलाशी जरूरी थी ताकि सरकार का राजस्व न ठगा जाए?
e: Governor Verelst ne 1767 me customs tatha navon ki jaanch ke niyam saaf karne ke liye kaha ki European companies ki navon ke saath bheje gaye dastak yaani parwane me unke maal ki poori jaankari likhi honi chahiye. Unke nirdesh me teen chowkies - Serampur, Jalangi (Jellingy) tatha Rajmahal - ka zikr tha; unhone kaha ki agar in chaukiyon par jaanch nahi hogi, to sarkar ka rajasv (lag) loota jaaega tatha European vyapari in ke beech padne wale ilaakon me bina lag diye vyapar karte rahenge. Unhone yah bhi dekha ki jab angrej tatha anya vyapari jaanch ka virodh nahi karte, to Dutch tatha French ke liye bhi virodh ka koi aadhaar nahi hona chahiye. Exam point: Verelst ne jaanch zaroori hone ke liye Serampur, Jalangi tatha Rajmahal chaukiyon ka naam liya; nirdesh tha ki European companies ki navon ke saath dastak yaani parwane me maal ki jaankari ho; jaanch na hone par rajasv ka nuksan hone ka khatra tha.

qe: The Dutch addressed several memorials of protest against the English opium monopoly in Bihar to which Governor at Calcutta?
qh: डचों ने बिहार में अंग्रेजों के अफीम एकाधिकार के विरुद्ध कई स्मारक (memorials) कलकत्ता के किस गवर्नर को भेजे?
e: Angrej East India Company ne 1761 me Bihar me afim ke nirman tatha vyapar par ekadhikar sthapna kar liya tha, jiske baad anya European companies ko is vastu ki sirf seemit matra hi kharidne ki anumati mili. Is niyam se Dutch tatha French companies naraz hui tatha unhone apni shikayat likhit roop me Governor Verelst ke paas memory yaani memorial bheje. Verelst ne 12 March 1767 ko Muhammad Reza Khan ko aadesh diya ki is vyapar me sabhi companies ko unka uchit hissa milne se roke jane wale avrodh door kiye jayein. Aise vivaran dikhate hain ki afim ke vyapar par niyantran 18vein sadi me angrejon tatha anya European companies ke beech ek bada vivaad ka mudda tha. Exam point: Dutch tatha French companies ne afim ekadhikar ke viruddh Governor Verelst ko kai memorial bheje; 12 March 1767 ko Verelst ne Muhammad Reza Khan ko unka uchit hissa dene ke liye avrodh hatane ka aadesh diya; angrej Company ne 1761 me yah ekadhikar sthapna kiya tha.
